title: The Eagle and the Fox
author: Aesop (adapted by J. H. Stickney)
summary: 鹰抓走小狐狸，狐狸妈妈举火要烧树，逼鹰还回孩子。
publicDomainBasis: Aesop's fables are ancient; this retelling by J. H. Stickney was published in 1915. Published before 1923 and therefore public domain in the United States; Project Gutenberg releases it as public domain.

paragraphs.en: ONE day a mother Eagle came flying out of her nest to look for food for her babies. She circled round and round, far up in the air, looking down upon the earth with her keen eyes.
paragraphs.zh: 有一天，一只母鹰飞出巢去给雏鹰找食。她在高空一圈一圈地盘旋，用锐利的眼睛俯视着大地。

paragraphs.en: By and by she saw a little baby Fox, whose mother had left it alone while, like the Eagle, she went for food.
paragraphs.zh: 不久，她看见一只小狐狸，狐狸妈妈像鹰一样出去找食，把它单独留下了。

paragraphs.en: Down came the bird, whir went her wings, and away she soared again, with the little Fox clutched fast in her claws.
paragraphs.zh: 鹰猛扑下来，翅膀呼呼作响，又腾空而起，爪子里紧紧抓着那只小狐狸。

paragraphs.en: The poor mother Fox just at that moment came running home to her child, and saw it being carried away.
paragraphs.zh: 可怜的狐狸妈妈恰好在这时跑回家来看孩子，看见它被叼走了。

paragraphs.en: “O Eagle!” she cried, “leave me my one little baby. Remember your own children, and how you would feel if one of them should be taken away. Oh, bring back my poor cub!”
paragraphs.zh: “哦，鹰啊！”她叫道，“把我唯一的小宝贝还给我吧。想想你自己的孩子们，要是它们被夺走，你会是什么滋味。哦，把我的小崽子还回来吧！”

paragraphs.en: But the cruel Eagle, thinking that the Fox could never reach her, in her nest high in the pine tree, flew away with the little Fox, and left the poor mother to cry.
paragraphs.zh: 可残忍的鹰以为狐狸永远够不到自己高踞松树上的巢，便带着小狐狸飞走了，留下可怜的妈妈哭喊。

paragraphs.en: But the mother Fox did not stop to cry long. She ran to a fire that was burning in the field, caught up a blazing stick of wood, and ran with it in her mouth to the pine tree where the Eagle had her nest.
paragraphs.zh: 可狐狸妈妈没有哭多久。她跑到田里一堆正在燃烧的火旁，叼起一根燃着的木柴，跑到鹰筑巢的那棵松树下。

paragraphs.en: The Eagle saw her coming, and knew that the Fox would soon have the tree on fire, and that all her young ones would be burned. So, to save her own brood, she begged the Fox to stop, and brought her back her little one, safe and sound.
paragraphs.zh: 鹰看见她跑来，知道狐狸很快会把树点着，自己所有的雏鹰都会被烧死。为了救自己的孩子，鹰只好求狐狸停下，把她的小宝贝安然无恙地还给了她。
